title: Proofs and disproofs of open OEIS conjectures
description: 12059 papers settling conjectures across 12032 entries of the On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences: 12053 proofs and 6 disproofs. Each was recorded as an open conjecture, empirical observation or unverified formula on its entry at the time it was settled. Each paper is self-contained, quotes its conjecture verbatim with contributor and date, and reports the ranges verified. Results were produced with AI assistance under the author's direction and were each checked by at least two independent routes; see the repository README for the method and its limits.
